evidence.quote: Current and conditional candidate peaks follow.

CA.rationale: No explicit attention/processing allocation claims linked to identified content; A absent.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions) and an explicit origin/organization entry are present for the same referent/time, and the origin separates content identity from organization/status.

A.rationale: Text contains no explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition linked to content organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (color labels with coordinate sets) are stated.

D.rationale: Content identification (red positions) is presented separately from its organization/origin metadata for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The report states display orientation and gives explicit origin/lineage metadata describing how content emerges/is represented.
